records.name: Susi Startsignal
records.biography_en: She is ready before the signal and suspicious immediately after it. She holds the starting blocks like an application that must never be submitted too early. HyperNorm classifies anticipation as enthusiasm until it becomes a false start. A dissonant card has taught her to let a nervous neighbour stand beside her. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie ist startbereit. Bitte erschrecken Sie sie jetzt nicht mit dem Start.

variant_notes.note_en: She is ready before the signal and suspicious immediately after it.

records.name: Hektor Hürde
records.biography_en: He regards each obstacle as a clerical repetition of the previous one. He carries a small hurdle to demonstrate that obstacles are repeatable and therefore probably intentional. The building files residents as cleared or pending. He has started wondering whether removing a barrier might count as a respectable performance. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die nächste Hürde ist dieselbe. Das spart Einarbeitung.

variant_notes.note_en: He regards each obstacle as a clerical repetition of the previous one.

records.name: Gitta Gewichtung
records.biography_en: She prefers arguments that can be weighed in one hand. She weighs the shot in her palm because the association accepts only heavy arguments or light-mindedness. A dissonant card points out that a gentle question can change a room. She now sets the sphere down before listening. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Argument wiegt. Es wird nur auf ausdrücklichen Wunsch vorgetragen.

variant_notes.note_en: She prefers arguments that can be weighed in one hand.

records.name: Lutz Luftlinie
records.biography_en: He measures success from the most flattering available edge. His tape begins wherever his last result looks most impressive. HyperNorm calls that optimisation unless a neighbour does it. An ambiguous card about a fair starting point has made him measure the space left for everyone else. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Weite ist beachtlich. Der Anfang wurde entsprechend gewählt.

variant_notes.note_en: He measures success from the most flattering available edge.

records.name: Viktor Vertikal
records.biography_en: He has achieved ambition and would now like a reliable way down. He carries the bamboo pole upright through a building that equates ambition with altitude. The approved categories are rising or disappointing. A dissonant card suggests that a safe return deserves its own applause, which is a considerable relief. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Aufstieg ist geklärt. Für unten fehlt noch ein Ansprechpartner.

variant_notes.note_en: He has achieved ambition and would now like a reliable way down.

records.name: Manni Morgennoch
records.biography_en: He believes the final kilometre is a renewable resource. He carries an enamel flask and the quiet suspicion that perseverance has become somebody else's cost saving. HyperNorm records only finishing or failing. He now keeps a little water for residents whose journey has no official finish line. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der letzte Kilometer wurde erneut bestätigt.

variant_notes.note_en: He believes the final kilometre is a renewable resource.
